div.div: Orange: external participant. Navy: transformation. Green open-ended symbol: retained data. * repeats the same participant or record family; it is not a new system/store. Accept-original includes mobile direct upload. Presigning binds one publishIntentId to a deterministic user-owned key and 24-hour Content upload lease; the signed PUT expires in 300 seconds and returns 412 when already present. Media completion persists validated HLS/thumbnail and queues evidence; attempt fencing, source preservation and opt-in cleanup are sequences 27–31.
